verdict.rationale: Community Phone's Business Team plan documents sharing one business number across a team, with multiple users, simultaneous ringing and live transfer. Nothing in the evidence shows agent presence/availability, assigning conversations to teammates, or internal comment threads, so only the shared-number part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: presence/availability indicators, conversation assignment, internal threads/notes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: Share your business number with your team. Dial menu. Live transfer
Add users and manage every number. Set up call routing and call forwarding
Incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once, or roll to different numbers if the first one isn’t answered
One number covers the front desk, back office, and warehouse — all on the same cordless system.
